model.title: Model
model.description: The image model available on your proxy — pick from the dropdown (the models your gateway exposes for image generation).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: A text description of the image you want to generate.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: Optional (local SDXL/ComfyUI gateways). What to avoid in the image. Ignored by hosted models like dall-e.

n.title: Number of Images
n.description: Optional. How many images to generate. Defaults to 1.

size.title: Size
size.description: Optional. Image dimensions. Pick a supported size for your model (square + common SDXL/dall-e aspect ratios).

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Optional (local SDXL/ComfyUI gateways). Number of diffusion steps (e.g. 20–30). Ignored by hosted models.

cfg.title: CFG Scale
cfg.description: Optional (local SDXL/ComfyUI gateways). Prompt-adherence / guidance scale (e.g. 6–8). Ignored by hosted models.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Optional (local SDXL/ComfyUI gateways). Fix the random seed for reproducible images; omit for a random seed.

lora_1.title: LoRA 1
lora_1.description: Optional (local SDXL/ComfyUI gateways). Pick a LoRA available on the gateway. Stack more with LoRA 2/3/4. Ignored by hosted models.

lora_1_strength.title: LoRA 1 Strength
lora_1_strength.description: How strongly to apply LoRA 1 (0–1.5; 1.0 = full).

lora_2.title: LoRA 2
lora_2.description: Optional. A second LoRA to stack on top of LoRA 1.

lora_2_strength.title: LoRA 2 Strength
lora_2_strength.description: How strongly to apply LoRA 2 (0–1.5; 1.0 = full).

lora_3.title: LoRA 3
lora_3.description: Optional. A third LoRA to stack.

lora_3_strength.title: LoRA 3 Strength
lora_3_strength.description: How strongly to apply LoRA 3 (0–1.5; 1.0 = full).

lora_4.title: LoRA 4
lora_4.description: Optional. A fourth LoRA to stack.

lora_4_strength.title: LoRA 4 Strength
lora_4_strength.description: How strongly to apply LoRA 4 (0–1.5; 1.0 = full).

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Optional (hosted models). Rendering quality: standard/hd for dall-e-3, or low/medium/high for gpt-image-1.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: Optional. How the image is returned: a URL or base64-encoded data.

keep_warm.title: Keep Model Warm
keep_warm.description: Optional (local SDXL/ComfyUI gateways). When true, the image model is kept loaded after this step instead of being unloaded — faster for back-to-back image steps, but holds GPU memory (blocks the large text model until a later non-warm render frees it). Leave off for one-off images.
